article.title: 案例補讀：Coty以Brandlight串連美妝內容與AI搜尋
article.title_en: Case review: Coty links beauty content with AI discovery through Brandlight
article.summary: Coty於10月27日公布與Brandlight合作，涵蓋生成式搜尋優化、量度、培訓及品牌團隊支援。
article.summary_en: Coty’s October 27 partnership with Brandlight covers generative-search optimization, measurement, training and brand-team support.
article.why: 美妝品牌可把內容、電商與公關納入同一AI可見度工作，而非獨立處理搜尋。
article.why_en: Beauty teams can coordinate content, ecommerce and PR within an AI-visibility program.

highlights_en: The release includes product pages, creator assets, digital PR and launch toolkits in early pilot work.

article.detail:
Coty於10月27日公布與Brandlight合作，涵蓋生成式搜尋優化、量度、培訓及品牌團隊支援。

公告把商品頁、創作者素材、digital PR及新品工具包納入早期試行。

合作重點包括非直接品牌名稱搜尋的產品發現。

美妝品牌可把內容、電商與公關納入同一AI可見度工作，而非獨立處理搜尋。

選一條非品牌需求問題，核對商品資料與可追溯的第三方來源。

此為10月27日公告的案例補讀，屬較早公告的案例補讀；試行未披露量化效果，不能保證排名或銷售。
article.detail_en:
Coty’s October 27 partnership with Brandlight covers generative-search optimization, measurement, training and brand-team support.

The release includes product pages, creator assets, digital PR and launch toolkits in early pilot work.

The partnership addresses discovery beyond direct brand-name searches.

Beauty teams can coordinate content, ecommerce and PR within an AI-visibility program.

Choose one unbranded buyer need and audit product information and traceable external sources.

This reviews an October 27 announcement, not a new deal today. Pilot results are unquantified and establish no ranking or sales guarantee.
